name: Quincy's Heating & Air Conditioning
evidenceNote: Quincy's official Panama City and Panama City Beach service pages expressly offer residential attic-insulation assessment and installation by the company's own crew. The official site identifies family-owned Frosty Comfort, Inc. DBA Quincy's, based in Panama City Beach and serving Bay County since 1979; this extends an existing regional directory identity to two independently supported insulation pages.
